subproblem.title: Pointwise tilt bound 1 − G ≤ 2(1 − |ξ(β)|) under radial tangency
subproblem.statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep of dimension 2 in ℝ^P (U = univ), μ := R.measure, T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x with orthogonal projection p_{T_x}. Let Q be a linear subspace with dim Q = 2 and orthogonal projection π, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, and β ∈ Covector(ℝ^P, 2) with β(v) = ⟨a, v₀⟩⟨e, v₁⟩ − ⟨a, v₁⟩⟨e, v₀⟩ for all v : Fin 2 → ℝ^P. Assume p_{T_x}x = x for μ-a.e. x. Put Ax := ⟨x, a⟩e − ⟨x, e⟩a and G(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|²/|πx|². Then (i) G(x) ≤ 1 for every x with ⟨x, a⟩ > 0; (ii) for μ-a.e. x: |ξ(x)(β)| ≤ 1, and if ⟨x, a⟩ > 0 then 1 − 2(1 − |ξ(x)(β)|) ≤ G(x).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (β : Covector (Euclid P) 2), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → (∀ v : Fin 2 → Euclid P, β v = inner ℝ a (v 0) * inner ℝ e (v 1) - inner ℝ a (v 1) * inner ℝ e (v 0)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection x = x) → (∀ x : Euclid P, 0 < inner ℝ x a → ‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, |R.orient x β| ≤ 1 ∧ (0 < inner ℝ x a → 1 - 2 * (1 - |R.orient x β|) ≤ ‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Notation: d(x) := ξ(x)(β) = R.orient x β.
1. (Basis of Q.) a and e are orthonormal, hence linearly independent; span{a, e} ⊆ Q has dimension 2 = dim Q, so span{a, e} = Q and (a, e) is an orthonormal basis of Q. Hence πx = ⟨x, a⟩a + ⟨x, e⟩e and |πx|² = ⟨x, a⟩² + ⟨x, e⟩² for all x.
2. |Ax|² = ⟨x, a⟩²|e|² − 2⟨x, a⟩⟨x, e⟩⟨a, e⟩ + ⟨x, e⟩²|a|² = ⟨x, a⟩² + ⟨x, e⟩² = |πx|².
3. (Claim (i).) Let ⟨x, a⟩ > 0. Then |πx|² ≥ ⟨x, a⟩² > 0. An orthogonal projection does not increase norms (also when T_x = ⊥, where p_{T_x} = 0), so |p_{T_x}(Ax)|² ≤ |Ax|² = |πx|², i.e. G(x) ≤ 1.
4. (A full-measure set.) μ = (H²⌞M).withDensity θ, so μ ≪ H²⌞M (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous; also the first conjunct of the accepted Submission.cbr_imRep_measure_basic). The field R.orients holds for H²⌞M-a.e. x, hence for μ-a.e. x; the hypothesis gives p_{T_x}x = x for μ-a.e. x. Fix x at which both hold: there is Q' with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt 2 M x Q' and IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ(x)) Q', and p_{T_x}x = x. It suffices to prove the two assertions of (ii) at such x.
5. (T_x = Q'.) Since ∃ Q', HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt 2 M x Q', by definition approxTangentPlane 2 M x is a chosen Q'' with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt 2 M x Q''; by uniqueness of approximate tangent spaces (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt.unique, Simon Ch. 3 Remark 1.5(1)), Q'' = Q'. So T_x = Q'.
6. (Orientation.) IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ(x)) T_x gives τ : Fin 2 → ℝ^P orthonormal with span{τ₀, τ₁} = T_x and a sign σ ∈ {1, −1} with ξ(x)(α) = σ·α(τ) for all covectors α. Put a_i := ⟨a, τ_i⟩, e_i := ⟨e, τ_i⟩ and D := a₀e₁ − a₁e₀. By the hypothesis on β, d(x) = σ·β(τ) = σD, so |d(x)| = |D| and d(x)² = D².
7. (|d| ≤ 1.) Lagrange's identity: (a₀² + a₁²)(e₀² + e₁²) − D² = (a₀e₀ + a₁e₁)² ≥ 0. By Bessel's inequality for the orthonormal family τ, a₀² + a₁² ≤ |a|² = 1 and e₀² + e₁² ≤ |e|² = 1. Hence D² ≤ 1, i.e. |d(x)| ≤ 1.
8. (Coordinates in T_x.) τ is an orthonormal basis of T_x, so p_{T_x}v = ⟨v, τ₀⟩τ₀ + ⟨v, τ₁⟩τ₁ and |p_{T_x}v|² = ⟨v, τ₀⟩² + ⟨v, τ₁⟩² for all v. Since p_{T_x}x = x, with x_i := ⟨x, τ_i⟩ we have x = x₀τ₀ + x₁τ₁, |x|² = x₀² + x₁², ⟨x, a⟩ = x₀a₀ + x₁a₁ and ⟨x, e⟩ = x₀e₀ + x₁e₁.
9. (Computation.) ⟨Ax, τ₀⟩ = ⟨x, a⟩e₀ − ⟨x, e⟩a₀ = (x₀a₀ + x₁a₁)e₀ − (x₀e₀ + x₁e₁)a₀ = x₁(a₁e₀ − a₀e₁) = −x₁D, and ⟨Ax, τ₁⟩ = (x₀a₀ + x₁a₁)e₁ − (x₀e₀ + x₁e₁)a₁ = x₀(a₀e₁ − a₁e₀) = x₀D. Hence |p_{T_x}(Ax)|² = D²(x₀² + x₁²) = D²|x|².
10. (Second part of (ii).) Let moreover ⟨x, a⟩ > 0. Then 0 < |πx| (step 3) and |πx| ≤ |x| (projection), so G(x) = D²|x|²/|πx|² ≥ D² = d(x)². Finally 1 − 2(1 − |d(x)|) = 2|d(x)| − 1 ≤ d(x)², because d(x)² − 2|d(x)| + 1 = (|d(x)| − 1)² ≥ 0. Therefore 1 − 2(1 − |d(x)|) ≤ G(x). ∎
proof_key_steps: (a, e) is an orthonormal basis of Q, so |πx|² = ⟨x, a⟩² + ⟨x, e⟩² = |Ax|²; projections are 1-Lipschitz, so G ≤ 1 where ⟨x, a⟩ > 0.
μ ≪ H²⌞M transfers R.orients; with radial tangency and uniqueness of approximate tangent planes, a.e. T_x has an orthonormal basis τ with ξ(x)(β) = ±D, D = ⟨a, τ₀⟩⟨e, τ₁⟩ − ⟨a, τ₁⟩⟨e, τ₀⟩.
Lagrange's identity and Bessel's inequality give D² ≤ 1.
x ∈ T_x gives |p_{T_x}(Ax)|² = D²|x|² ≥ D²|πx|², so G ≥ d² ≥ 2|d| − 1 = 1 − 2(1 − |d|).

audit.reason: Absolute continuity transfers orientation, and tangent uniqueness identifies the chosen plane. Bessel's inequality bounds |ξβ|; radial coordinates give ‖p_T(Ax)‖² = |ξβ|²‖x‖². Positivity of the denominator on the stated half-space then proves both exact inequalities.
